name: Whisperwound
body:
Source Dirty Tactics Toolbox pg. 9
Price 5,000 gp; Weight —
Type ingested; Save Fortitude DC 20
Onset 1 minute; Frequency 1 round
Effect 1d6 Constitution damage. As long as any Constitution damage from this poison remains, the target finds it physically painful to speak above a soft whisper. Whenever the subject attempts to speak in a loud, clear voice—such as when casting a spell—he takes 2d6 points of damage
Cure 1 save
